thought.text: Growth data shows how fast the economy is expanding. Over time it shapes expectations for company earnings and for which sectors may be doing better or worse.

items.title: Bharti Airtel Q2 preview: Higher Arpu, subscriber upgrades to drive earnings

thought.topic: How company results reach the index
thought.text: Company results update expectations about profits. Large companies carry more weight in the indices, so their results can matter more for index moves than those of smaller ones.
